SELECT DISTINCT m.chembl_id, m.pref_name AS compound_name, s.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary m
JOIN compound_structures s ON m.molregno = s.molregno
JOIN docs d ON m.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123892'
  AND s.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chembl_id ASC, m.pref_name ASC, s.canonical_smiles ASC;
